notes: Firmographics: mid-tier financial data provider (market data + analytics) with heavy real-time inference needs for customer-facing products.
Primary constraint: data residency + audit trail — must keep PII in customer VPC; leaning toward Redwood Dedicated with Private control plane.
Ownership: AE = Maya Chen; SE = Ethan Morales; Dir Eng sponsor = Rajiv Patel; Security contact = Liza Moreno.
Stage summary: POC started 2025-01-20. Running dedicated capacity evals for 2 model classes: reranker (instruction-tuned transformer) and conversational assistant (chat with long context).

POC goals: verify throughput guarantees (sustained 400 qps reranking, peak 700 qps burst), validate latency SLOs (p95 <= 150ms for reranker on reserved pool), and quantify token cost with quantized variants.
Observed baseline (hosted): reranker p95 ~210ms on public endpoint; unacceptable for live trading signals.

Model preferences: want to use a tuned Llama-3-70B variant for chat and a distilled 13B reranker. Interested in q4_0 and int8 quantization profiles; concerned about hallucination/regression after quantization.
Context length needs: chat sessions up to 64k tokens for legal/financial threads. Need kernel selection that supports longer KV caching without p95 regression.

Batching / KV cache: prefer aggressive prefix KV caching for multi-turn chats to reduce recompute; max_batch_size target for reranker = 256 requests per batch during nightly backlog windows; latency-sensitive path should use smaller batches (<= 8) with pre-warmed KV nodes.

Reserved GPU planning: initial ask = 8x H100 equivalent for dedicated pool (mixed sizes: 6 H100 + 2 A100 for compatibility). Plan includes burst band (on-demand) up to +50% for earnings-report spikes.

SLA negotiation notes: legal pushed back on SLA credit tiering — they're requesting 99.95% for production, 99.8% for non-critical. Also want 4 hour RTO for regional failover and guaranteed warm standby capacity during market hours.

Quantization evaluation plan: run A/B perf+quality test matrix: fp16 vs qint8 vs q4_0 across sequence lengths {512, 2048, 16384}. Quality gates: reranker NDCG drop <= 1.5 pts; chat summary ROUGE drop <= 2%.

Throughput guarantees: Redwood asked to provide token/sec baselines per GPU shape + expected sustained throughput for the customer's mixed workload; customer requests per-model SLOs and routing policy for fallbacks to smaller quantized variant under capacity pressure.

Cost sensitivity: medium-high; willing to commit to 12-month reserved if unit cost delta < 30% vs on-demand compute; looking for transparent per-token accounting and cost dashboard (Redwood Console requirement).
Timeline: decision target EOM Mar 2025. Procurement window narrow (legal + security must sign prior to finance approval).
